description: Python test script for validating Ethsw HAL API functions CcspHalEthSwSetPortCfg() and CcspHalEthSwGetPortCfg() by setting link rate and duplex mode to Auto, including setup, execution, verification, and cleanup.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: Library class providing methods to load modules, configure test cases, and execute test steps.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the module load operation.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the module loading process.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test functions.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the test case with expected result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the test step execution.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed output from the test step.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the pass/fail status of the test step.
